# Inventory

The service exposes [user routes](../app/users.py) and a
[Go server](../svc/server.go#routes).

## Usage

Call `read_me` or `Routes`; the native side is `compute_hash`.
See [the guide](GUIDE.md) and [upstream](https://example.com).

## Models

`UserPublic` travels between `app.users.UserPublic` and the client.
